## About Soloinsight
CloudGate by Soloinsight is a unified Physical Identity and Access Management (PIAM) platform delivering Physical Identity Governance across the enterprise. The platform serves organizations in professional services, healthcare, energy, commercial real estate, and critical infrastructure, governing all identity types through a single policy engine, a single data model, and a single codebase.
​
CloudGate provides unified identity governance, workflow automation, and compliance through a cloud-native, integration-first architecture. Soloinsight deploys through a certified partner ecosystem of domain-expert implementation firms, enabling scalable enterprise delivery with standardized methodology in any industry or geography.

## What CloudGate Delivers
CloudGate by Soloinsight governs the full physical identity lifecycle across every identity type, every facility, and every connected system.
##### Complete Identity Lifecycle Governance
One authoritative record for every identity that interacts with your physical infrastructure. Automated provisioning, role transitions, and access termination that execute across all connected systems the moment a governance decision is made.
##### Comprehensive Policy Enforcement
Define governance policies once. Enforce them everywhere. Your compliance team defines the rules. The platform enforces them automatically, consistently, and without manual intervention across every facility.
##### Unified Multi-System Governance
Your enterprise runs different access control systems across different locations from different manufacturers. CloudGate governs all of them from a single control plane. Governance decisions execute everywhere, instantly.
##### Continuous Compliance Evidence
Every governance decision produces a complete audit record: who approved access, under what policy, at what time, and what the system enforced. Continuous compliance replaces periodic manual audits.
##### No Rip and  
Replace
CloudGate layers on top of your existing access control infrastructure. No hardware replacement. No system migration. Governance deploys on top of your current investments.
##### Credential Governance
Employee badge in Apple Wallet, Google Wallet, and Samsung Wallet, governed by the same policies that apply to every other credential in your enterprise.
##### Cloud-Native  
SaaS
SOC 2 certified. 100% software. Vendor-neutral. Patented technology. Extensive integration ecosystem across major access control, HR, and identity platforms.
##### Configured for Any Industry
One platform. One architecture. Configured to your governance requirements without custom development.
